Changelog

gevplus 1.0.1

Bug fixes

  • Bootstrap confidence intervals in return.level() (with do.ci = TRUE) and plot() (with ci = TRUE) now respect the GEV+ constraint. Each bootstrap replicate is refitted with fgevplus() instead of an unconstrained GEV, so replicates can no longer have a negative shape parameter, and the switch to a Gumbel fit uses the same L-skewness threshold as the original fit. This affects fits with method = "Lmoments". For data where the fitted shape is 0, lower confidence bounds of long return periods are noticeably higher (previously too wide). MLE fits are unchanged.

Internal

  • The bootstrap code shared by return.level() and plot() now lives in a single internal helper.
  • Test coverage increased to 100%, including new tests for plot().
  • Documentation website built with pkgdown and published at https://haraldschellander.github.io/gevplus/, with test coverage reported to Codecov.

gevplus 1.0.0

  • First release: fgevplus() fits the GEV distribution constrained to non-negative shape parameters (Moccia et al., 2021) using L-moments or MLE, with return.level(), print() and plot() methods.
